ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT Ou athJAvvny January AGREEMENT made as of the day of August, 2023 by and between Gem M. Brutus & Maxienne K. Brutus, having an address at 356 Dean Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217 ("Owner") and Dean 132 LLC with an address 14 Niagara Street, Staten Island, NY 10301 ("Developer"). WHEREAS, Owner is thefee owner of a certain parcel ofland, with the buildings and improvements constructed thereon,located in the County of Kings, City and State of New York,known as 356 Dean Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217 designated as Block 198, Lot 32 on the Tax Map of The City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map"), all as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land is herein WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements constructed thereon, located in the County of Kings, City and State of New York, known as 354 Dean Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217 designated as Block 198, Lot 132 on the Tax Map, all as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land is herein referred to as *"Developer's Parcel"). WHEREAS, Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel are contiguous for more than ten (10) linear feet and are within a singleblock pursuant to theZoningResolution of the City of NewYork effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, the building located on Owner's Parcel contains less floor area as defined in the Zoning Resolution (herein referred to as “Floor Area") than is now available for use on the Owner's Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if the Owner's Parcel were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, so that the Transferred Excess Development Rights (hereafter defined) attributable to the Owner Parcel are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel; and upon all or a portion of Developer's Parcel with Floor Area in excess of that permitted to be constructed on Developer's Parcel under the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Parcel were considered as a separate and independent “zoning lot,"; and WHEREAS, Developer and Owner so desire to combine the Developer's Parcel and the Owner's Parcel into a single “zoning lot”' to enable the New Developer Building to incorporate all of the Transferred Excess Development Rights into its construction on Developer's Parcel; and WHEREAS, the Parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a“Declaration”(hereafter defined) in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12- Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS, all Parties in Interest (hereafter defined) to the Merged Zoning Lot as shown on the hereto as Exhibit C, have joined in the Declaration or have waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement, or subordinated thereto; and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to set forth the rights and obligations of each with respect to development and certain related activities on their respective portions of the Merged Zoning Lot: WHEREAS, the owner's parcel shall provide a Light & Air Easement for the developer'sparcel 1
